description: Defines reference counting and binding pointer classes for OpenGL objects in the ANGLE project, including lifecycle management, cross-context deletion support, and observer pattern integration.

classes.name: RefCountObject
classes.description: Base class providing reference counting for GL objects, supporting cross-context deletion.

classes.name: BindingPointer
classes.description: Template class managing object references with reference counting, supporting offset binding and observer pattern.

classes.name: RefCountObject (specialization with IDType)
classes.description: Template subclass adding an ID to RefCountObject for specific object identification.

classes.name: OffsetBindingPointer
classes.description: Extension of BindingPointer supporting offset and size management for buffer objects.

classes.name: SubjectBindingPointer
classes.description: Binding pointer that also manages observer registration for subject objects.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and deletes the object if count reaches zero.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a new object, managing reference counts appropriately.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the ID of the object (for specialized classes).

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a subject object and manages observer registration.
